Private key blocks, JWTs, URL passwords, Authorization values, and a secret
key's value in each shape: shell, YAML, JSON, TOML, URL query and connection
string. See README.md for the format. A private key's secret is its body: its
BEGIN and END lines are split so the raw file holds no block.

=== secret private_key rsa block with its end line
The deploy key, before I rotate it:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE¦ KEY-----
'⟦MIIEowIBAAKCAQEAx7Qp¦2Lr9Vt4Nm1Kj6Hg3Fd8Sa5Wq0EzRb7Yc4Ud1Ef0Gh5IjKl9Mn
OpQrStUvWxYz0AbCdEfGhIjQx7Lm2Pv¦Tn8sRb3Yc6Ud1Ef0Gh5IjKl9MnOpQrSt⟧'
-----END RSA PRIVATE¦ KEY-----
Then run ssh-add.

=== secret private_key openssh block without an end line
pasted from the terminal:
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE¦ KEY-----
'⟦b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAA¦BG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAAB⟧'

=== secret private_key ec block in a json string
{"type": "service_account", "private_key": "-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE¦ KEY-----\n'⟦MHcCAQEEIBk7Rt2Vx9Lp4Nz8¦Kc1Hw6Jy3Fb5Gd0Se7Ua2Xi4Ok9oAoGCCqGSM49⟧'\n-----END EC PRIVATE¦ KEY-----\n", "client_email": "ci@acme.example"}

=== secret private_key pgp block
-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE¦ KEY BLOCK-----

'⟦lQOYBGVx7QpBCADr2Lr9Vt4¦Nm1Kj6Hg3Fd8Sa5Wq0EzRb7Yc4U⟧'
-----END PGP PRIVATE¦ KEY BLOCK-----

=== secret private_key generic pkcs8 block in yaml
tls:
  key: |
    -----BEGIN PRIVATE¦ KEY-----
    '⟦MIIEvgIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAS¦CBKgwggSkAgEAAoIBAQDf3Gk⟧'
    -----END PRIVATE¦ KEY-----

=== secret jwt bare jwt in a log line
2026-11-02T10:14:03Z auth ok token '⟦ey¦JhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.ey¦JzdWIiOiJ1LTQ0MiIsImV4cCI6MTc5OTk5OTk5OX0.Qm7Rt2Vx9Lp4¦Nz8Kc1Hw6Jy3Fb5Gd0Se7Ua2Xi4Ok9⟧' issued

=== secret jwt jwt in a cookie header
Cookie: theme=dark; id_token='⟦ey¦JhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.ey¦JpZCI6Ijk5In0.Zx8Qp2Lr7¦Vt4Nm1Kj6Hg3Fd9Sa5Wq0E⟧'

=== secret jwt jwt in json
{"access": "'⟦ey¦JhbGciOiJFUzI1NiJ9.ey¦JzY29wZSI6InJlYWQifQ.Ab3dEf6hIj¦9lMn2pQr5tUv8xYz⟧'", "expires_in": 3600}

=== secret url_password https clone url
git clone https://alice:'⟦hunt¦er2Pass9⟧'@git.acme.example/team/app.git

=== secret url_password postgres url
DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:'⟦Tr0ub4¦dor3x77⟧'@db.internal:5432/app

=== secret url_password redis url in yaml
cache:
  url: redis://default:'⟦c4cheP¦assW0rd⟧'@redis.internal:6379/0

=== secret url_password mongodb srv url
mongodb+srv://reporting:'⟦Mng0Rep¦0rt1ng2026⟧'@cluster0.acme.example/?retryWrites=true

=== secret url_password amqp url in prose
the worker connects to amqp://worker:'⟦Rabb1tQ¦ueue55⟧'@mq.internal:5672/ and retries

=== secret url_password ftp url
ftp://upload:'⟦FtpUpl0¦adPw⟧'@files.acme.example/incoming/

=== secret auth_header bearer header
Authorization: Bearer '⟦Zx8Qp2Lr7Vt4¦Nm1Kj6Hg3Fd9Sa5Wq0E⟧'

=== secret auth_header basic header
authorization: Basic '⟦YWxpY2U6¦c2VjcmV0UGFzcw==⟧'

=== secret auth_header token header
Authorization: token '⟦a1b2c3d4e5¦f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8⟧'

=== secret auth_header curl header
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer '⟦Qm7Rt2Vx9L¦p4Nz8Kc1Hw6Jy3F⟧'" https://api.acme.example/v2/me

=== secret auth_header json header
{"headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer '⟦Kc1Hw6Jy3F¦b5Gd0Se7Ua2Xi4⟧'", "Accept": "application/json"}}

=== secret auth_header bare bearer
then pass bearer '⟦Ux3Yc6Wd1¦Ef0Gh5IjKl9Mn⟧' to the client

=== secret key_value_shell export line
export DB_PASSWORD='⟦Sh3llPa¦ss2026x⟧'

=== secret key_value_shell env file
APP_ENV=production
API_KEY='⟦k3yV4lu3¦Xy9Zq2Wp⟧'
LOG_LEVEL=info

=== secret key_value_shell assignment before a command
PGPASSWORD='⟦PgPassw¦0rd88⟧' psql -h db.internal -U app

=== secret key_value_shell docker env flag
docker run -e CLIENT_SECRET='⟦cl13ntS¦ecr3tV4l⟧' acme/api:1.4

=== secret key_value_yaml password key
database:
  host: db.internal
  password: '⟦Yaml9Pa¦ssw0rd!⟧'

=== secret key_value_yaml quoted token
github:
  token: "'⟦tok3nY¦amlQu0ted⟧'"

=== secret key_value_yaml api key in a list
providers:
  - name: search
    api_key: '⟦s3archK¦eyV4lue⟧'

=== secret key_value_json api key
{"api_key": "'⟦js0nApi¦K3yValue⟧'", "region": "eu-west-1"}

=== secret key_value_json password in a nested object
{"db": {"user": "app", "password": "'⟦N3stedP¦w0rd99⟧'"}}

=== secret key_value_json client secret
"client_secret": "'⟦Cl1entS¦ecretJs0n⟧'",

=== secret key_value_toml secret key
[service]
secret = "'⟦t0mlSec¦retVal⟧'"

=== secret key_value_toml access key
[storage]
access_key = "'⟦AccK3yT¦oml2026⟧'"

=== secret key_value_toml passphrase single quoted
passphrase = ''⟦T0mlPas¦sPhrase⟧''

=== secret key_value_query access token in a callback
redirected to https://app.example.com/cb?access_token='⟦ya2Abc12¦3Def456⟧'&expires_in=3599

=== secret key_value_query second pair in a query
https://x.example/cb?state=abc&refresh_token='⟦R3fr3shT¦ok3nQ⟧'&next=/home

=== secret key_value_query form body
curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_secret='⟦F0rmB0dy¦Secr3t⟧'&client_id=app'

=== secret connection_string sql server
Server=db.internal;Database=app;User Id=sa;Password='⟦SqlS3rv¦erPw!1⟧';

=== secret connection_string odbc pwd
DRIVER={ODBC Driver 18};SERVER=db;UID=report;PWD='⟦0dbcPwd¦Value7⟧'

=== secret connection_string jdbc query
jdbc:mysql://db.internal:3306/app?user=app&password='⟦Jdbc9Pa¦ssw0rd⟧'&useSSL=true

=== secret connection_string azure service bus
Endpoint=sb://acme.servicebus.example/;SharedAccessKeyName=send;SharedAccessKey='⟦Kq8Wn3Xp7Rt2Lm5Vb9Zc4Hd1Fg6Js0¦Yu3Ea8Ti2Ow7Pk=⟧'
